onboarding.welcomeBody: Structured lessons to learn from, AI practice to try things out on, and real teachers when you're ready for a person.

level.some: I can have a simple conversation

onboarding.goalExplainer: Short and regular beats long and rare. You can change this any time.
onboarding.remindersBody: One notification at a time you choose. No streak-guilt spam.
